The Titanic disaster was so deadly mainly because the ship did not carry enough lifeboats.
Many people died. The main reason: too few lifeboats.
People on board: 2,223. Lifeboat seats: 1,176.
the ship was fulfilling all the requirements of the British Board of Trade.
Saved: 706. Lost: 1,517.
On the third day out ice warnings were received by the wireless operators on the Titanic.
the ship was going not less than 21 knots and the ship's speed was not reduced.
There should be enough lifeboats for all on board.
Mrs. O'Leary's cow did not start the Great Chicago Fire. The cow story came from a newspaper, and the real cause is unknown.
The famous cow story is not true. Nobody knows how the fire started.
we are unable to determine whether a spark from a chimney or a person started it.
A reporter, Michael Ahern, later said that he and other reporters made up the cow story. Accounts disagree about the year he said it.
The fire started in or near the O'Leary family's barn on DeKoven Street.
Chicago after the fire, 1871.
In 1997, the Chicago City Council passed a resolution clearing Mrs. O'Leary and her cow.
About 300 people died, and about 100,000 people lost their homes.

The existence of an area of free land, its continuous recession, and the advance of American settlement westward, explain American development. The most important effect of the frontier has been in the promotion of democracy.
Turner says: there was open land in the West, and settlers kept moving west. This is why America grew the way it did, and why it became more democratic.
there can hardly be said to be a frontier line.
An Act to provide for an exchange of lands with the Indians residing in any of the states or territories, and for their removal west of the river Mississippi.
A settler could claim 160 acres of public land by living on it and farming it for five years.
In 1869, Wyoming Territory gave women the right to vote, before any state did.
In 1890, Mississippi's new constitution added a poll tax and a literacy test. They were used to stop Black men from voting.
In 1619, colonists in Virginia met as an elected assembly, the House of Burgesses.
contributed to. helped bring about an effect alongside other causes. Too few lifeboats contributed to the deaths.
was one reason for. was one cause among others. Westward settlement was one reason for American development.
because of. connects an effect to its cause. The claim is limited because of the voting barriers.
as a result. introduces an effect of a cause. There were too few lifeboats; as a result, seats were limited.
led to. connects a cause to an outcome. The Homestead Act led to settlement in the West.
caused. states a direct cause. The cow caused the fire is a strong claim.
was the main cause of. claims one cause mattered most. Ship speed was the main cause of the collision is stronger than one cause.
shows. points to evidence clearly. The table shows the lifeboat shortage.
suggests. points to a possible conclusion. The saved and lost table suggests filling the boats mattered too.
supports. gives a reason to accept a claim. The inquiry finding supports uncertainty about the fire.
according to. names the source of information. According to the Senate report, there were 1,176 seats.
this is clear from. connects a conclusion to evidence. The shortage is clear from the people and seats table.
convincing. well supported by the evidence you weighed. The claim about the cow story needs convincing evidence.
partly convincing. some support, with limits or thin evidence. A claim can be partly convincing when it leaves out the ship’s speed.
however. introduces a counter-point. However, ice warnings complicate the lifeboat explanation.
although. concedes a point before giving a limit. Although settlement mattered, the claim leaves out Native removal.
overlooks. fails to consider something relevant. Turner overlooks the removal of Native nations.
ignores. does not take evidence into account. The main-cause claim ignores the ship speed clue.
leaves out. does not include a relevant part. The claim leaves out the voting barriers.
goes too far. claims more than the evidence justifies. Turner’s claim goes too far.
may. marks a possibility. The cow may have started the fire.
might. marks a possibility with uncertainty. The photograph might help explain the damage.
probably. marks something likely, still uncertain. More than one cause probably mattered in the Titanic disaster.
it is likely that. expresses a likely conclusion with a limit. It is likely that boat filling mattered too.
Too few lifeboats caused the deaths.
Too few lifeboats contributed to the deaths.
caused / contributed to
The cow started the fire.
The cow may have started the fire.
started / may have started
Free land explains American democracy.
Free land was one reason for American democracy.
explains / one reason for
The ice warnings show the crew was careless.
The ice warnings suggest the crew could have slowed down.
show / suggest
The speed was the main cause of the collision.
The speed was one cause of the collision.
main cause / one cause
This photo proves the cause of the fire.
This photo shows the damage from the fire.
proves the cause / shows the damage
The Homestead Act led to settlement in the West.
The Homestead Act helped lead to settlement in the West.
led to / helped lead to
Turner’s claim is wrong.
Turner’s claim goes too far.
wrong / goes too far
